name: JoAi: Schedule Social Post

description.en: Queue a draft to publish. Set a time, or leave it empty to queue it for the next job run. The network post happens later via JoAi's publish job - this warp only schedules.
description.de: Plane einen Entwurf zur Veröffentlichung. Mit Zeit oder leer für den nächsten Job-Lauf. Der Netzwerk-Post kommt später über JoAis Publish-Job - dieser Warp plant nur.

bot: Use after a draft exists. This warp only schedules into JoAi's queue; PublishSocialPostJob posts to the network later. scheduledAt is optional - omit it to queue for immediate publish (still via the job, not in this warp). Interpret unnamed times in the team timezone. The response includes shareUrl for a public preview the user can review.

inputs.name: Post

description.en: Social post ID (public hashid, not an internal database id)

inputs.bot: Opaque public hashid from the list or get API. Never use a numeric internal database id — only the public hashid (or slug where documented).

description.en: When JoAi should publish. Omit to queue for immediate publish via the job.
description.de: Wann JoAi veröffentlichen soll. Weglassen reiht es für sofortigen Publish über den Job ein.

success.en: Social post scheduled. Preview: {{shareUrl}}. JoAi will publish it when due.
success.de: Social-Post geplant. Vorschau: {{shareUrl}}. JoAi veröffentlicht ihn zum Termin.
